English-Wizard.question: ১) They saved money meticulously in order to buy their dream house. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) They saved money meticulously and so they wanted to buy their dream house.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) They saved money meticulously so therefore they wanted to buy their dream house.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) They wanted to buy their dream house therefore so they saved money meticulously.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) They wanted to buy their dream house and so they saved money meticulously.
English-Wizard.exp:
• • Simple sentence এ to অথবা in order to থাকলে Compound Sentence এ পরিণত করতে তিনটি কাজ করতে হয় -
- যথা-
(1) Clause গুলোর অবস্থান উল্টে যাবে।
(2) ‘want to’ অতিরিক্ত যোগ হবে।
(3) ‘and so/ therefore’ Conjunction যোগ হবে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে - They wanted to buy their dream house and so they saved money meticulously.

• Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
- অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।
- এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি coordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে।

English-Wizard.question: ২) Because of his being unprepared, he struggled during the exam. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) As he was unprepared, he struggled in the exam.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) He was unprepared so that he struggled during the exam.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) He was unprepared therefore he struggled during the exam.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Since he was unprepared therefore, he struggled during the exam.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Because of যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex-এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Simple sentence এ because of থাকলে Complex sentence এ because of এর স্থলে As/since ব্যবহৃত হয়
- Subject বসে + Verb বসে
- Adjective /Noun বসে
- Comma বসে
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর - As he was unprepared, he struggled in the exam.

English-Wizard.question: ৩)  In case of his not abiding by the rules, the authority will punish him. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Unless he does not abide by the rules, the authority will punish him.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Unless he abides by the rules, the authority will be punished him.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) If he does not abide by the rules, the authority will be punished him.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) If he does not abide by the rules, the authority will punish him.
English-Wizard.exp:
• By/ In case of যুক্ত simple sentence টি যদি Modal auxiliary যোগে গঠিত হয়, তবে তা complex sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম -
-  in case of এর পরিবর্তে  if বসে
- Subject বসে + Verb বসে
- Adjective /Noun বসে
- Comma বসে
- অপর বাক্যটি বসে।
- আর মূল Clause টি Future/ Present হলে If যুক্ত Clause টি Present Tense হয়।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর - If he does not abide by the rules, the authority will punish him.
• Unless নিজেই negative অর্থ প্রদান করে বিধায় এর সাথে আর কোনো negative শব্দ বসাতে হয় না।

English-Wizard.question: ৪) Notwithstanding being a rich man, he treats everyone with respect and kindness. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) He is a rich man yet so he treats everyone with respect and kindness.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) He is a rich man and so he treats everyone with respect and kindness.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) He is a rich man yet he treats everyone with respect and kindness.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) He is a rich man and he treats everyone with respect and kindness.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Notwithstanding = সত্ত্বেও
- In spite of/ despite/ notwithstanding এর পরিবর্তে Compound Sentence এ but/ yet বসে।
- প্রথমে subject + verb বসে,
- but/yet  বসে।
- দুইটি clause এর subject একই হলে দ্বিতীয় clause টিতে subject বসাতে হয় না।

• অন্যভাবে বলা যায়, 
i) Despite/ in spite of/ notwithstanding যুক্ত Phrase টাকে Clause বানিয়ে বাক্যের শুরুতে বসাতে হবে।
- এ Clause টা বসানোর সময় অন্য Clause টার Tense কে অনুসরণ করতে হবে।
- অন্য Clause টা Past Tense হলে এটাও Past Tense হবে। 
ii) মাঝখানে Conjunction- but/yet বসবে। 
iii) অন্য Clause টা বসবে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, He is a rich man yet he treats everyone with respect and kindness. - সঠিক উত্তর।

English-Wizard.question: ৫) Despite being a rich man, he leads a very simple life. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Although he is a rich man, he leads a very simple life.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) As though he is a rich man, he leads a very simple life.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Though being a rich man, he leads a very simple life.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Though he is a rich man that he leads a very simple life.
English-Wizard.exp:
• In spite of/ Despite / notwithstanding = সত্ত্বেও.
- Simple sentence এ in spite of/ Despite / notwithstanding থাকলে complex করতে হলে, 
- প্রথমে এদের পরিবর্তে though/ although বসে
- এর পর Subject+ Tense অনুযায়ী Verb বসে।
- পরবর্তী অংশ বসে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, Although he is a rich man, he leads a very simple life - সঠিক বাক্য।

English-Wizard.question: ৬) Akash hoped to succeed in life. (Make it compound)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Akash had a hope and he would succeed.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Akash had a hope and it was to succeed in life.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Akash hoped and to succeed in life.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Akash had a hoped so was to succeed in life.
English-Wizard.exp:
• to + verb যদি Object/ Object সদৃশ হয়, তাহলে Compound করার সময় ‍and it is /and it was + to + verb বসে।
- Object সদৃশ বলতে বুঝায়, Noun/ Adjective এর  অন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object হওয়া।
- to + verb যদি পূর্বের Verb এর  Object হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়, তাহলে to + Verb দিয়ে সার্বিকভাবে যা বুঝাচ্ছে এ রকম একটা Object ব্যবহার করে এর পর and it is/was + to + Verb বসবে। 

• প্রশ্নে উল্লেখিত বাক্যে, To + Verb টি Hope- Noun এর অনন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object সদৃশ হয়েছে।
- মূল Clause এর Verb (hope) Past Tense হওয়ায়, এ Clause টাও Past Tense এ হবে।
- তবে to + verb সাধারণত Future Indicate করে, তাই এখানে Past Future (would) হবে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, সঠিক উত্তর - He had a hope and it was to succeed in life.

English-Wizard.question: ৭) Sadia wants to earn money. (Make it Complex)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Sadia wants that she will earn money.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Sadia wants so therefore she will earn money.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) As Sadia wants, she will earn money.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Sadia wants and so she will earn money.
English-Wizard.exp:
• To + Verb - Object বা Object সদৃশ হলে Complex Sentence এ that + Clause বসে।
এখানে To + Verb টি money- Noun এর অনন্তর্নিহিত Verb এর Object সদৃশ হয়েছে।

- মূল Clause এর Verb (wants) present Tense হওয়ায়, এ Clause টাও present Tense এ হবে।
- তবে to + verb সাধারণত Future Indicate করে, তাই এখানে Future (will) হবে। 
- তবে মনে রাখতে হবে, to + verb  যদি উদ্দেশ্য বুঝানোর জন্য আসে, তখন সাধারণত so that বা in order that যুক্ত Clause বসে।

• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, সঠিক উত্তর - Sadia wants that she will earn money.

English-Wizard.question: ৮) She is too lazy to cook her breakfast. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) She is so lazy so she cannot cook her breakfast.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) She is very lazy so that she cannot cook her breakfast.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) She is so lazy that she cannot cook her breakfast.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) She is very lazy that is why she cannot cook her breakfast.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Simple sentence এ too + adjective + to + verb থাকলে Complex এ too এর স্থলে So এবং to এর স্থলে that বসে।
Example:
Simple: She is too lazy to cook her breakfast. 
complex: She is so lazy that she cannot cook her breakfast.

English-Wizard.question: ৯) Which of the following can be the simple form of the sentence - 'He worked hard and prospered in life.'?
English-Wizard.option1: ক) By working hard, he prospered in life.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Working hard, he prospered in life.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Because of working hard, he prospered in life.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) All of these
English-Wizard.exp:
• And যুক্ত compound sentence কে কয়েক ভাবে simple sentence এ পরিবর্তন করা যায় -

• Compound এ and দ্বারা দুটি কাজ যুক্ত থাকলে simple এর শুরুতে প্রথম  verb টি + ing হয়।
• অথবা Because of + verb + ing হয়।
• আবার, By + verb + ing বসিয়েও simple sentence এ পরিণত করা যায়।

যেমন - 
• Compound sentence - 'He worked hard and prospered in life.
• Simple sentence: 
- Working hard, he prospered in life.
- Because of working hard, he prospered in life.
- By working hard, he prospered in life.

English-Wizard.question: ১০) Inaaya worked hard and I rewarded her. (Make it complex)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) Inaaya worked hard so that I rewarded her.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Inaaya worked hard so I worked rewarded her.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) As Inaaya worked hard, i rewarded her.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Since Inaaya worked hard, so i rewarded her.
English-Wizard.exp:
• কারণ +And + ফলাফল = > As/ Since/ Because+ কারণ + ফলাফল
- অর্থাৎ, and যুক্ত compound sentence এর প্রথম clause টি যদি কারণ এবং এরপরের cluse টি ফলাফল নির্দেশ করে - 
- তবে, As/ Since/ Because+ কারণ + ফলাফল এভাবে complex sentence এ পরিণত করতে হয়।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী - As Inaaya worked hard, i rewarded her - সঠিক বাক্য।

English-Wizard.question: ১১) The bakery only sells fresh bread in the morning. (Make it negative)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) The bakery only sells anything but fresh bread in the morning.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) The bakery only sells nothing but only fresh bread in the morning.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) The bakery only sells none but only fresh bread in the morning.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) The bakery only sells nothing but fresh bread in the morning.
English-Wizard.exp:
• অপশনে সঠিক উত্তর না থাকায় প্রশ্নটি বাতিল করা হয়েছে।

• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Only দিয়ে ব্যক্তিকে নির্দেশ করলে, Negative করার সময়, only এর পরিবর্তে None but বসে।
- আর Only দিয়ে বস্তু বা ধারণাকে নির্দেশ করলে, Negative করার সময় Only এর পরিবর্তে Nothing but বসে।
- আর Only দিয়ে বয়স/ সংখ্যা ইত্যাদি নির্দেশ করলে, Negative করতে হলে Only এর পরিবর্তে Not more than বসে।

• এখানে যেহেতু only দিয়ে খাবার অর্থাৎ বস্তুবাচক কিছুকে নির্দেশ করছে তাই সঠিক Negative form হবে -
- The bakery sells nothing but fresh bread in the morning.

English-Wizard.question: ১২) Which of the following can be the negative form of the sentence - 'Everybody hates a liar.'?
English-Wizard.option1: ক) There is nobody who likes a liar.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) There is nobody but hates a liar.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Nobody likes a liar.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) All of these
English-Wizard.exp:
Everybody +verb কে কয়েকভাবে Negative করা যায়:
1. There is nobody + who + negative verb
- There is nobody who likes a liar.

2.  Every এর পরিবর্তে There is no বসে + every এর পরের শব্দটি বসে + but + প্রদত্ত sentence এর বাকি অংশ।
- There is nobody but hates a liar.

3. Nobody + Opposite verb
- Nobody likes a liar.

সুতরাং, এর সঠিক উত্তর - All of these।

English-Wizard.question: ১৩) Sanjida is always on time.  (Make it negative)
English-Wizard.option1: ক)  Sanjida is never late.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) Sanjida does not come late.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) Sanjida is not always on time.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Sanjida does not fail to come on time.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Affirmative Sentence এ always থাকলে negative করার নিয়ম: 
- Always এর পরিবর্তে never বসাতে হয়, 
- Verb, noun বা adjective কে পরিবর্তিত করে বিপরীতার্থক করতে হয়। 
- এখানে on time এর বিপরীতার্থক শব্দ হচ্ছে late.
 
• নিয়মানুযায়ী,
Affirmative: Sanjida is always on time.
Negative: Sanjida is never late.

Other examples: 
Affirmative: He is always sick. 
Negative: He is never well. 
Affirmative: He always loves me. 
Negative: He never hates me. 

Source: A Passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

English-Wizard.question: ১৪) You cannot but obey your parents. (Make it Affirmative)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) You can but disobey your parents.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) You must obey your parents.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) You always have to obey your parents.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) You should obey your parents.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- Negative এ cannot but থাকলে Affirmative এ এর পরিবর্তে must বসে।-
- Example -
Negative: You cannot but obey your parents.
Affirmative: You must obey your parents.

English-Wizard.question: ১৫) None but the graduates were allowed to apply for the post. (Make it affirmative)
English-Wizard.option1: ক) The graduates were only allowed to apply for the post.
English-Wizard.option2: খ) The graduates alone were allowed to apply for the post.
English-Wizard.option3: গ) The graduates were allowed to apply only for the post.
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Alone the graduates were allowed to apply for the post.
English-Wizard.exp:
• Transformation এর নিয়মানুযায়ী,
- -বাক্যে None but থাকলে,
- Affirmative এ None but এর ঠিক পরের Noun টির পূর্বে only বা পরে alone বসে।

• Example:
Negative: None but the graduates were allowed to apply for the post.
Affirmative:
- Only the graduates were allowed to apply for the post.
- The graduates alone were allowed to apply for the post.

English-Wizard.question: ১৬) What is the meaning of the phrase 'Far and away'?
English-Wizard.option1: ক)  Everywhere
English-Wizard.option2: খ) By a very large amount
English-Wizard.option3: গ) To be dead and buried
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) At a very distant place
English-Wizard.exp:
• Far and away (Phrase)
- English Meaning: By a very large amount.
- Bangla meaning: খুব বেশি মাত্রায়, অতুলনীয়।

Example Sentence: He is far and away the most accomplished player.
অর্থঃ খেলোয়ার হিসেবে তার অর্জন অতুলনীয়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১৭) Instead of 'Certainly' we can say -
English-Wizard.option1: ক) By and by
English-Wizard.option2: খ) By far
English-Wizard.option3: গ) By no means
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) By all means
English-Wizard.exp:
• By all means
English Meaning: of course / certainly (granting a permission).
Bangla Meaning: খুব আগ্রহের সাথে অনুমতি দেওয়া বুঝাতে ; অবশ্যই, নিশ্চয়ই

• অন্য অপশন গুলোর মধ্যে - 
• By no means
English Meaning: not at all / certainly not
Bangla Meaning: কোনোভাবেই না

• By far
English Meaning: by a great amount.
Bangla Meaning: অনেক বেশি পরিমাণে বা মাত্রায়

• By and by
English Meaning: before long / eventually / ultimately / shortly.
Bangla Meaning: অবশেষে / অনতিকাল মধ্যে / অবিলম্বে / দেখতে দেখতে

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ১৮) Complete the idiom with appropriate word: Chip of the ________ block.
English-Wizard.option1: ক) great
English-Wizard.option2: খ) finest
English-Wizard.option3: গ) old
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) fittest
English-Wizard.exp:
• Chip of the old block (idiom)

English Meaning: someone who resembles their parents in character or appearance.
Bangla Meaning: পিতা বা মাতার মত হওয়া / বাপকা বেটা

Ex. Sentence: He was a chip of the old block.
Bangla Meaning: সে একদম বাপের মতই হয়েছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture

English-Wizard.question: ১৯) What is the meaning of the phrase 'Fall about'?
English-Wizard.option1: ক) become detached
English-Wizard.option2: খ) drop to the ground
English-Wizard.option3: গ) laugh uncontrollably
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) Quarreling with someone
English-Wizard.exp:
• Fall aboutn

English Meaning: laugh uncontrollably / to laugh without being able to stop.
Bangla Meaning: হাসিতে ভেঙ্গে পড়া

Ex. Sentence: We fell about when we heard her reply.
Bangla Meaning: তার উত্তর শুনে আমরা হাসিতে ভেঙ্গে পড়লাম।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English-Wizard.question: ২০) I shall do it at no time. Here the phrase 'at no time' refers to -
English-Wizard.option1: ক) near in time
English-Wizard.option2: খ) never
English-Wizard.option3: গ) after a long time
English-Wizard.option4: ঘ) immediately
English-Wizard.exp:
• At no time
English Meaning: never / not ever.
Bangla Meaning: কখনোই না।
